Note. The index is the proportion of eligible deficits present, each item scored from 0 (no deficit) to 1, excluding items flagged as psychological symptoms. All 40 items were collected at baseline (MIDUS 2, Refresher 1) and at the MIDUS 3 follow-up; the Refresher 2 follow-up carried neither angina nor chest pain, so its index is built from 38 items. Where an item combines several variables, the score column states the rule. Item 9, loneliness, is the one psychosocially adjacent item retained (SI Methods); Table S2 lists the predictors coded for overlap with the items.
